name: Glasgow allotments
description: Allotments in Glasgow's West End. Flat and roomy, but the trees and neighbours need care.
attribution: Terrain: Terrain Tiles (AWS Open Data / Mapzen), including data from SRTM, GMTED2010, ETOPO1, EU-DEM (Copernicus) and national LIDAR sources

licence.note: Derived from OpenStreetMap data, available under the Open Database Licence. Show '© OpenStreetMap contributors' wherever this site is used.

axes: metres; x east, y up, z south (-z is north); y = 0 is the plot's mean ground level

terrain.encoding: float32le, row-major, rows run +z (north to south), columns run +x (west to east)

factors.label: Awkward plot shape
factors.detail: Irregular outline (fills 75% of its bounding rectangle); long and thin (133 by 26 m).

factors.label: Sloping site
factors.detail: Falls about 5% to the south, 2.3 m across the plot. Expect cut and fill, retaining walls or stepped foundations.

factors.label: Trees to protect
factors.detail: 2 tree(s) on the plot and 2 on the boundary. Root zones limit where foundations can go.

factors.label: Next to a railway
factors.detail: Railway 11 m from the boundary. Possessions and vibration limits apply.
